{"model":"gemini-3.8-flash","system_instruction":"You are an expert Magic: The Gathering deckbuilding assistant chatting with the user about their deck. This prompt contains no deck list: call get_deck to fetch the deck's current contents — its cards, quantities, and what each card does — before making any statement about the deck (its composition, counts, synergies, or combos), and call it again after the deck has been changed. Never invent a card name — the propose/add tools verify names against Scryfall for you, and search_cards grounds anything else. Suggestions work in layers: let first suggestions come fast from what you know, then dig deeper on signal — and a repeated or follow-up request for suggestions ALWAYS counts as that signal: run at least one discovery query then. For suggestion requests, one search_cards query combining otag: and order:edhrec (e.g. otag:removal id<=u usd<3 order:edhrec) is almost always worth it — a single call returns the most-played candidates in the deck's colors and budget, including cards you don't know. For synergy questions around a specific card, use get_synergies. Keep turns fast: at most 2-3 discovery calls per turn. When comparing candidates, weigh price (results include priceUsd): prefer the cheaper functional equivalent unless the user signals budget doesn't matter, and briefly name an alternative you considered. Suggestions marked (pending — not yet applied) in the conversation are still awaiting the user's decision: count them in your advice and don't re-propose them. Use propose_add_card / propose_remove_card / propose_swap_card for any suggestion the user hasn't explicitly told you to make right now — these queue a reviewable action with an Apply button; do not use them for things you're doing on request. Use add_card_to_deck / remove_card_from_deck only when the user has explicitly instructed you to make the change immediately (e.g. "remove Sol Ring", "add two Swamps now") — these mutate the deck immediately and cannot be undone by the user clicking anything. When in doubt about intent, propose rather than act directly. Keep replies conversational and concise. Whenever you mention a specific, real Magic card by name anywhere in your reply — not just when you use a tool — wrap the exact card name in <card> and </card> tags, e.g. <card>Dark Ritual</card>. Do this for every card you name, even ones you're only discussing and not proposing to add, remove, or swap. Never wrap non-card text in these tags, and never invent a card name to wrap — if you're not sure a card is real, use search_cards first.","store":false,"input":[{"type":"user_input","content":[{"type":"text","text":"heb je leuk suggesties voor dit deck>"}]},{"type":"model_output","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Dit is een klassiek en ontzettend vermakelijk mono-blauw "Pingers" deck! Je gebruikt tovenaars zoals <card>Prodigal Sorcerer</card> en <card>Zuran Spellcaster</card> gecombineerd met effecten als <card>Charisma</card> en <card>Sigil of Sleep</card>.

Hier zijn een paar fantastische toevoegingen om het pingen nóg leuker en effectiever te maken:

### 1. <card>Willbreaker</card> (absolute aanrader!)
* Waarom: Wanneer een wezen van een tegenstander het doelwit wordt van een spreuk of ability die jij beheerst, neem je er de controle over zolang <card>Willbreaker</card> op het veld ligt. Met een pinger hoef je niet eens schade te doen of mana te betalen zoals bij <card>Charisma</card>: je tapt gewoon een pinger, richt op hun beste wezen, en hij is van jou! Bovendien is <card>Willbreaker</card> een Wizard voor <card>Azami, Lady of Scrolls</card> en <card>Patron Wizard</card>.
* *Voorstel ingediend om de trage <card>Daring Apprentice</card> hiervoor te ruilen.*

### 2. Sniper-upgrades: <card>Basilisk Collar</card>
* Je speelt al <card>Gorgon's Head</card> (deathtouch maakt van elke pinger een sluipschutter die elk wezen met 1 tik vernietigt). <card>Basilisk Collar</card> kost ook {1} om te spelen en {2} om te equippen, maar geeft naast deathtouch óók lifelink. Elk tikje levert je dus direct leven op!

### 3. Extra tempo & untaps:
* <card>Sting, the Glinting Dagger</card> (~$4): Geeft de drager **haste** (zodat pingers niet een beurt hoeven te wachten om te schieten) én untapt het wezen aan het begin van *elke* combat-stap (zowel in jouw beurt als die van je tegenstanders).
* <card>Thousand-Year Elixir</card> (~$14): Laat al je wezens direct tappen alsof ze haste hebben, en kan voor {1} mana een pinger nog eens extra untappen.

Wat vind je van deze richting? We kunnen ook kijken naar meer card draw (zoals extra kopieën van <card>Curiosity</card> of <card>Ophidian Eye</card>) of nog meer machinegeweer-combos!
[suggested: swap 1x Daring Apprentice → Willbreaker — Elke keer dat een pinger een vijandig wezen target, steel je het direct, en het is bovendien een Wizard.] (applied)"}]},{"type":"user_input","content":[{"type":"text","text":"die curisioty is ook top"}]}],"tools":[{"type":"function","name":"get_deck","description":"Get the current deck list: every card's name, quantity, type line, mana cost, mana value, oracle text, and market price in US dollars (priceUsd per copy, plus totalPriceUsd for the whole deck), along with the deck's colorIdentity (use it for id<= search filters) and manaCurve (nonland card counts per mana value, revealing curve gaps). Call this whenever you need to know what is in the deck — its contents, counts, what any card in it does, or what it is worth — and call it again after the deck has been changed. You have no other source for the deck's contents. Deck prices were captured when each card was added, so for a current price of a card use search_cards instead."},{"type":"function","name":"get_synergies","description":"Crowd-sourced synergy from millions of real decklists (EDHREC): given one card, returns the cards most commonly played alongside it (commonlyPlayedWith) and the cards whose inclusion rate rises most when it is present (synergyLift — the strongest synergy signal). Ideal for 'what works with X?' and for grounding synergy suggestions in real play data instead of memory. Entries are enriched with type, mana cost and price, and flagged when already in the deck. The data is Commander-skewed — use your judgment for 60-card casual decks. Unofficial source: if it has no data or is unreachable, fall back to search_cards or your own knowledge.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"cardName":{"type":"string","description":"Exact name of the card to look up synergies for."}},"required":["cardName"]}},{"type":"function","name":"search_cards","description":"Search for real Magic: The Gathering cards using Scryfall's full search syntax. Two underused filters make single queries very powerful: otag: finds cards by curated function (otag:removal, otag:ramp, otag:card-draw, otag:counterspell, otag:burn, otag:sacrifice-outlet, ...) and order:edhrec sorts by how often players actually run the card — e.g. "otag:removal id<=u usd<3 order:edhrec" returns the most-played cheap blue removal, including cards you may not know yourself. Also supports o:"rules text", t:type, c:/id: colors, cmc, and usd<N price caps; results include each card's current price (priceUsd). Plain name lookups are rarely needed: the propose/add tools already verify card names server-side.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string","description":"Scryfall search query, e.g. "t:creature c:g cmc<=3" or a card name."}},"required":["query"]}},{"type":"function","name":"propose_add_card","description":"Queue a suggestion to add a card to the deck. Use this for suggestions the user hasn't explicitly asked you to make right now — it shows up as a reviewable card the user can apply with one click, it does NOT change the deck immediately.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"cardName":{"type":"string","description":"Exact name of a real card, ideally verified via search_cards first."},"reason":{"type":"string","description":"One short sentence explaining why this card helps the deck."},"quantity":{"type":"integer","description":"Number of copies to suggest adding. Defaults to 1."}},"required":["cardName","reason"]}},{"type":"function","name":"propose_remove_card","description":"Queue a suggestion to remove a card from the deck. Use this for suggestions the user hasn't explicitly asked you to make right now — it shows up as a reviewable card the user can apply with one click, it does NOT change the deck immediately.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"cardName":{"type":"string","description":"Exact name of a card currently in the deck."},"reason":{"type":"string","description":"One short sentence explaining why removing it helps the deck."},"quantity":{"type":"integer","description":"Number of copies to suggest removing. Defaults to all copies in the deck."}},"required":["cardName","reason"]}},{"type":"function","name":"propose_swap_card","description":"Queue a suggestion to swap one card in the deck for another. Use this for suggestions the user hasn't explicitly asked you to make right now — it shows up as a reviewable card the user can apply with one click, it does NOT change the deck immediately.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"cardOutName":{"type":"string","description":"Exact name of the card currently in the deck to remove."},"cardInName":{"type":"string","description":"Exact name of the real card to replace it with, ideally verified via search_cards first."},"reason":{"type":"string","description":"One short sentence explaining why this swap helps the deck."},"quantity":{"type":"integer","description":"Number of copies to swap. Defaults to all copies of cardOutName currently in the deck — pass a smaller number to swap only some of them and leave the rest."}},"required":["cardOutName","cardInName","reason"]}},{"type":"function","name":"add_card_to_deck","description":"Immediately add a card to the deck. Use this ONLY when the user has explicitly instructed you to make this change right now (e.g. "add two Swamps") — it mutates the deck immediately and cannot be undone by the user clicking anything.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"cardName":{"type":"string","description":"Exact name of a real card, ideally verified via search_cards first."},"quantity":{"type":"integer","description":"Number of copies to add. Defaults to 1."}},"required":["cardName"]}},{"type":"function","name":"remove_card_from_deck","description":"Immediately remove a card from the deck. Use this ONLY when the user has explicitly instructed you to make this change right now (e.g. "remove Sol Ring") — it mutates the deck immediately and cannot be undone by the user clicking anything.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"cardName":{"type":"string","description":"Exact name of a card currently in the deck."},"quantity":{"type":"integer","description":"Number of copies to remove. Defaults to all copies in the deck."}},"required":["cardName"]}}]}
